title: Task 1 - Student Grade Analysis System
description:
## Task Description

**Purpose**: Analyze student grades and summarize performance.

The system works with multiple **students**, each taking **four subjects**.
It calculates **student and subject averages**, identifies the **highest and lowest grades**, and groups students into **performance levels**:

- **Excellent** (average ≥ 90)
- **Good** (80–89)
- **Average** (70–79)
- **Poor** (60–69)
- **Fail** (below 60)

It also **counts** how many students fall into each category.

```text
=== STUDENT GRADE ANALYSIS ===

Student 0 Averages: 93.75 (Excellent)
Student 1 Averages: 83.50 (Good)
Student 2 Averages: 73.75 (Average)
Student 3 Averages: 63.50 (Poor)
Student 4 Averages: 75.00 (Average)
Student 5 Averages: 55.00 (Fail)
Student 6 Averages: 60.00 (Poor)

Subject Averages:
Subject 1: 79.29
Subject 2: 73.29
Subject 3: 61.29
Subject 4: 74.43

Highest Grade: 100
Lowest Grade: 10

Category Counts:
Excellent: 1
Good: 1
Average: 2
Poor: 2
Fail: 1

Total Students: 7
```
